strings.pluginname_desc: The PayPal module allows you to set up paid courses.  If the cost for any course is zero, then students are not asked to pay for entry.  There is a site-wide cost that you set here as a default for the whole site and then a course setting that you can set for each course individually. The course cost overrides the site cost.
strings.privacy:metadata:enrol_paypal:enrol_payp: Information about the PayPal transactions for PayPal enrolments.
Email address or PayPal account ID of the payment recipient (that is, the merchant).
The ID of the course that is sold.
The ID of the enrolment instance in the course.
The full name of the course that its enrolment has been sold.
A note that was entered by the buyer in PayPal website payments note field.
In the case of a refund, reversal, or cancelled reversal, this would be the transaction ID of the original transaction.
Holds whether the payment was funded with an eCheck (echeck), or was funded with PayPal balance, credit card, or instant transfer (instant).
The reason why payment status is pending (if that is).
The reason why payment status is Reversed, Refunded, Canceled_Reversal, or Denied (if the status is one of them).
Primary email address of the payment recipient (that is, the merchant).
Unique PayPal account ID of the payment recipient (i.e., the merchant).
Amount of tax charged on payment.
The time of Moodle being notified by PayPal about the payment.
The merchant's original transaction identification number for the payment from the buyer, against which the case was registered
The ID of the user who bought the course enrolment.
strings.privacy:metadata:enrol_paypal:paypal_com: The PayPal enrolment plugin transmits user data from Moodle to the PayPal website.
Address of the user who is buying the course.
City of the user who is buying the course.
Country of the user who is buying the course.
A hyphen-separated string that contains ID of the user (the buyer), ID of the course, ID of the enrolment instance.
Email address of the user who is buying the course.
First name of the user who is buying the course.
Last name of the user who is buying the course.
